description: The drowned layer — underwater POIs are a province acceptance criterion and the catalogue has drowned/submerged place families to feed. Reef and bed flora (coral at three scales, seaweed, algae, kelp, driftwood, water rock-grass) from Depths of Skyrim with the 174995 corrected meshes, its wreck family (Atmoran longship/rowboat/warship, Bretic carrack half-wrecks) for sunken structures, and SIRENROOT's free-standing broken/hollow ruin blocks and WALKABLE rubble floors, which give a submerged ruin a swimmable, standable interior. Culture-neutral: wrecks and reefs belong to no building culture, so this kit may be combined with any settlement kit at a shoreline. Depths of Skyrim's WRECK family is excluded wholesale: Depths of Skyrim references ship-wood and carving textures it does not ship and no pool we hold supplies, so every hull exports as a grey slab. Sunken-hull dressing therefore comes from the boat pools (SBOT wrecks, BM&V drowned shells) instead; what this kit takes from Depths is its reef and bed flora, which is the part that is genuinely unique and correctly textured.
